title: Identifying Multiple Personalities in Large Language Models with External Evaluation
reasoning: The paper raises "societal and ethical concerns" regarding LLM behavior and their integration into human daily applications, including mental health support. It discusses the need to study LLM behaviors for reliability, safety, and ethics. The core finding—that LLMs exhibit different personalities in different roles, unlike humans—leads to a call for "re-evaluation of personality definition and measurement in LLMs," which has significant ethical implications for how LLMs are understood and deployed.
